title: Datapan registered operation document evidence v2
description: Redacted, digest-bound facts parsed from official operation documentation. Sample values and response rows are never retained. This evidence does not itself authorize execution.

result_collection.description: For JSON, path is the exact array JSON Pointer, container_path is its parent object Pointer, and item_path is null. For XML/SOAP, path is null; container_path is an absolute QName path that selects the required collection container, and item_path is the repeated QName path relative to that selected container. A consumer can distinguish a missing XML container (indeterminate) from a present container with zero matching items (apply reviewed empty-result policy). XML facts remain unknown unless both selectors are explicit in the source schema.

path.description: JSON only: exact array selector. Null for XML/SOAP.

container_path.description: JSON parent object selector or absolute XML container QName selector.

item_path.description: Null for JSON; for XML/SOAP, repeated QName selector relative to container_path.
